# Audex Trace

Audex Trace is a macOS Apple Music companion for Lossless and Hi-Res listeners.

Official site: https://trace.audex.dev/

Download: https://trace-auth.audex.dev/download?version=1.2&source=llms_txt

Release notes: https://github.com/audexdev/trace-releases/releases/tag/v1.2

Changelog: https://trace.audex.dev/changelog.html
Privacy: https://trace.audex.dev/privacy.html
Sample rate mismatch guide: https://trace.audex.dev/apple-music-sample-rate-mismatch-mac.html

Current version: 1.2

Minimum macOS version: macOS 15

Primary supported player: Apple Music on macOS

Key features:
- Apple Music mini player for macOS
- Playing Next queue with up to 3 upcoming Apple Music tracks
- Queue quality estimates for Lossless and Hi-Res availability before playback starts
- Skip warnings for upcoming tracks that may fail or skip
- Playback format readout for codec, bit depth, and sample rate
- Output sample-rate match status
- Experimental Auto Sample Rate Match
- Menu bar and notch player views
- Built-in Compatibility Check before purchase

Pricing:
- Free download for Compatibility Check, basic detection test, basic now playing, limited preview, and confirming your setup works before paying.
- Audex Trace Pro launch offer: $19.99 one-time purchase
- Playing Next queue is included in the free download.
- Pro includes queue quality estimates, skip warnings, playback readout, output match status, Auto Sample Rate Match, and a lifetime license.
- Regular price: $29.99 one-time purchase
- No subscription

Known limitations:
- Apple Music Song Transitions, AutoMix, or Crossfade can make playback-format detection delayed or unavailable around track changes.
- Auto Sample Rate Match depends on the output device exposing compatible macOS sample rates.
- macOS 14 and earlier are not officially supported.

Apple Music sample rate mismatch guide:
- Explains why Apple Music on Mac can show Lossless or Hi-Res Lossless while the selected macOS output format in Audio MIDI Setup remains fixed.
- Covers searches such as Apple Music sample rate mismatch Mac, Apple Music sample rate not changing, Audio MIDI Setup sample rate, DAC sample rate Mac, and Apple Music Hi-Res Lossless output.
- Clarifies that Apple Music playback format and Mac output sample rate are different layers.
- Recommends checking Music audio quality settings, Audio MIDI Setup, output device support, and DAC or audio interface sample-rate displays.

Privacy summary:
- Playback format detection runs locally on the Mac.
- Audex Trace does not modify, enhance, record, or upload audio.
- License verification, update checks, purchase checkout, artwork fallback, and minimal website download/checkout counts may use the network.
- No listening history is uploaded for audio-quality detection.
- No Apple Music account sign-in or cloud library API access is required.
- Website download and checkout events may be counted with minimal, non-audio data for release demand and purchase conversion measurement.

FAQ:

Q: What is Audex Trace?
A: Audex Trace is a macOS Apple Music companion that shows playback format details such as codec, bit depth, sample rate, output match status, and what is coming next in Playing Next.

Q: Does Audex Trace change Apple Music audio?
A: No. Audex Trace does not modify, enhance, record, or upload audio. Playback format detection runs locally on the Mac.

Q: Can Audex Trace automatically match the Mac output sample rate?
A: Audex Trace Pro includes experimental Auto Sample Rate Match for compatible output devices that expose matching macOS sample rates.

Q: Which macOS version does Audex Trace require?
A: Audex Trace requires macOS 15 or later and the Apple Music app.

Q: Where can I download Audex Trace?
A: Audex Trace is distributed through GitHub Releases from the official site at https://trace.audex.dev/.
